eyebrow: an independent lab for artistic and scientific inquiry
headline: we give questions
form
and let those forms
question us.
practice: through language, images and working models, we explore how relationships take shape, what holds through change, and what becomes possible when things meet.
boundary: a website is a living surface. the research it presents keeps becoming.

w.title: a form you can enter.
w.lead: expression gives the body a perceptible surface: type, space, geometry and the small gestures that make a place readable.
w.detail: this is where the display is composed. it presents what the body carries and what orientation resolves; it does not invent destinations to make the picture more elaborate.

x.title: what holds through change.
x.lead: continuity carries the wording and distinctions that remain available when their appearance changes.
x.detail: a public surface can be revised without forgetting what it says or where it came from. the landing-page contract lives here. there are no invented publications waiting behind it.

z.title: every step is a place.
z.lead: orientation makes your present place legible, along with the other ways it can be approached.
z.detail: an address is not a picture coordinate. each named step opens its whole prefix, and another approach can meet it at the same place. the names come from the body’s actual differentiations; turning the view changes neither location nor meaning.

y.title: a surface in becoming.
y.lead: renewal gives a changing website a repeatable way to test, correct and regenerate its skin.
y.detail: the builder and checks live here. they let the surface change without losing the distinctions it carries. a difficult interaction is an invitation to return, revise and try again.
